title: Front page

fields.label: How this page works
fields.message: The front page is one 3D film around the car. Each tab on the left is one chapter, in page order. Camera angles and effects are part of the theme; here you edit the texts, numbers and still images.

fields.label: Show chapter
fields.name: hero_show
fields.instructions: Turn off to hide this chapter. The camera skips it too.

fields.label: Anchor ID
fields.name: hero_anchor
fields.instructions: Used by the menu: a menu link "#top" scrolls here. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only. Change the menu link too if you change this.

fields.label: Still, desktop
fields.name: hero_still
fields.instructions: Render of this chapter's camera angle, landscape 16:9, 2560 × 1440 px. Shown when 3D is off (reduced motion, weak devices, effects off).

fields.label: Still, mobile
fields.name: hero_still_mobile
fields.instructions: Optional. Render of the portrait camera angle, 9:19.5 (a phone screen), 1200 × 2600 px. Used on portrait screens. If empty, the desktop still is cropped using the focal point.

fields.label: Focal point
fields.name: hero_focal
fields.instructions: Which part of the still must stay visible when it is cropped: horizontal and vertical position in %, for example "50% 50%" (centre) or "30% 60%".

fields.label: Headline
fields.name: hero_title
fields.instructions: The main headline of the site (the only H1). Keep it under 40 characters.

fields.label: Sentence
fields.name: hero_text
fields.instructions: One or two lines under the headline.

fields.label: Button label
fields.name: hero_cta_label
fields.instructions: Name the action, for example "See the spec sheet".

fields.label: Button target
fields.name: hero_cta_anchor
fields.instructions: Anchor ID of the chapter the button scrolls to.

fields.label: The car
fields.message: These settings apply to the whole film. Leave the files empty to use the model and lighting that come with the theme.

fields.label: 3D model, desktop
fields.name: scene_model
fields.instructions: Optional. Prepared .glb file, up to 4 MB. If empty, the theme's model is used.

fields.label: 3D model, mobile
fields.name: scene_model_mobile
fields.instructions: Optional. Lighter .glb, up to 2 MB. If empty, the desktop model is used.

fields.label: Reflections (night HDRI)
fields.name: scene_env
fields.instructions: Optional. .hdr or .ktx2, up to 1 MB. Sets what the paint reflects. If empty, the theme's night city is used.

fields.label: Paint colour
fields.name: scene_paint
fields.instructions: Base colour of the car. Default is Black Sapphire Metallic (#050608). Applies to the live 3D scene; phones and slower computers play a pre-rendered video with the default look, which has to be rendered again after a change (DESIGN.md → Video version).

fields.label: Paint gloss
fields.name: scene_clearcoat_roughness
fields.instructions: Lower is glossier. Default 0.012. Applies to the live 3D scene; phones and slower computers play a pre-rendered video with the default look, which has to be rendered again after a change (DESIGN.md → Video version).

fields.label: Driving speed
fields.name: scene_speed
fields.instructions: Speed of the road, wheels and street lights. Default 1. Applies to the live 3D scene; phones and slower computers play a pre-rendered video with the default look, which has to be rendered again after a change (DESIGN.md → Video version).

fields.label: Model credit
fields.name: scene_model_credit
fields.instructions: Shown in the footer. Keep the author and licence of the 3D model here.
fields.default_value: 3D model “BMW M6 (E63)” by Mona x Supercars, CC BY 4.0.

fields.name: rev_redline

fields.label: Figures
fields.name: rev_figures
fields.instructions: Big numbers that count up while the needle climbs. One to four rows. "At rpm" is where the counter reaches its value.
